capture: Run ./gradlew --offline --no-daemon runGameTestServer with CREATE_PENDING_CLUTCH=write, then run it again with CREATE_PENDING_CLUTCH=read. Repeat in the separate world selected by CREATE_PENDING_CLUTCH_DROPS=on or off. GameTest startup resets block drops, so the off case disables it in both processes before the first restored kinetic tick.
layout: Two X-axis Clutch rigs with a +32 Creative Motor and a second adjacent motor. The opposite branch runs at -64 in lane 0 and +64 in lane 1. Redstone powers the Clutch on tick 3 and releases it on tick 8. The write world shuts down on the closing action tick while reconnection is queued.
sampling: Phase tick counts from GameTest start in each process. Java records the queuing and first restored updates; its game clock can start at a different absolute time on reopen. Horizon compares the saved outcome at write tick 8 and the settled read tick 48 outcome over three ticks after a cold native launch.
